title: Hashable constraints and ordered uniqueness
summary: Constrain a generic function to Hashable and use Set.insert to preserve the first occurrence of each value.
triggers: remove duplicates while keeping first-seen order for any hashable element
prompts: Deduplicate a list of IDs while preserving their original order.
invariant: seen contains exactly the values encountered so far; only first insertions pass the filter.
mantra: Insert once; keep only new members.
pitfalls: Converting the input to a Set and back loses its order.
Hashable includes Equatable; the constraint enables set membership.
